summary: 27-year-old woman dislocated her shoulder traversing from Ellingwood Point toward Blanca Peak (epileptic with recent seizures); AVSAR and Rio Grande County SAR inserted via Flight for Life and 4x4s, performed a low-angle technical lowering to Crater Lake in a hail/lightning storm, bivouacked overnight, and FFL airlifted her from Blue Lake the next morning to Pueblo.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR / Rio Grande County SAR / Flight for Life
notes: AVSAR 2010 archive narrative; National Guard hoist request declined; bystanders (nurse, Army medic) assisted until SAR arrival
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Alamosa County, Colorado, United States)
